info.name: Data Capture: Quote and Risk Data

description.content:
This API provides a channel for partner systems to feed quote and risk data directly into Beazley's core Record of Risk systems. Please use the sandbox version of this API for initial development and testing. The current version of this API is V2.

Please contact ITArchitecture@Beazley.com if you have any questions about this API.
